personal.bio: I build distributed platforms, intelligent developer tooling, and applied machine learning workflows with a focus on clean systems architecture, reliable delivery, and practical engineering.

projects.title: Microservice Drift Tracker (MDT)
projects.subtitle: Cross-Service Impact & Drift Analysis Platform
projects.description: An AI-assisted cross-service impact analysis framework for microservice architectures. Ingests git commits via webhooks, performs AST diff parsing, builds service dependency graphs in Neo4j, retrieves semantic context with ChromaDB, and calculates deployment blast-radius using the HMDA risk-scoring engine.

projects.title: Cat-X: Operator Shift Twin
projects.subtitle: In-Cab Telemetry & Consequence Engine
projects.description: Intelligent in-cab companion and consequence engine developed for the Caterpillar Hackathon 2026. Models operator shift telemetry in real time, evaluates proximity hazards and seatbelt compliance, detects machine fatigue anomalies, and simulates forward operational trajectories.

projects.title: AI-Based PPT Explainer & Video Generator
projects.subtitle: Cloud-Deployed ML Pipeline
projects.description: An automated pipeline deployed on AWS EC2 that converts PowerPoint slides into narrated videos. Extracts text using python-pptx, generates contextual explanations using FLAN-T5, synthesizes speech via Amazon Polly, syncs lip movements using Wav2Lip GAN, and renders the final video with FFmpeg.

projects.title: Luxon
projects.subtitle: Full-Stack Luxury E-Commerce Platform
projects.description: Full-stack e-commerce marketplace featuring luxury merchandise, dynamic filtering, wishlists, cart session workflows, and Razorpay checkout. Includes a dedicated admin portal for live inventory management, order processing, and Cloudinary media pipelines.

projects.title: AI Disease Prediction Model
projects.subtitle: Gene Expression Classification
projects.description: A gene-expression microarray classifier that compares multiple machine-learning models across selected top-N gene subsets. The deployed interface accepts a test CSV, runs evaluation against bundled training data, and returns disease-class predictions with model metrics.

projects.title: WeatherVision
projects.subtitle: Zero-Dependency Atmospheric Analytics
projects.description: High-performance atmospheric monitoring dashboard built with a zero-dependency Python standard library server. Visualizes real-time weather metrics, Air Quality Index (AQI), hourly precipitation graphs, and cross-city comparison profiles with GPU-accelerated motion.

projects.title: AgriConnect
projects.subtitle: Full-stack Agricultural Platform
projects.description: Full-stack platform designed to centralize agricultural data and schemes. Built to improve usability and access to critical information for farmers using a robust React-based frontend and MongoDB backend.

projects.title: 3D Architecture Visualization System
projects.subtitle: Interactive 3D Walkthrough
projects.description: An interactive 3D walkthrough system for architectural visualization. Built using Blender for modeling and Unity for the interactive experience, integrating Python and OpenGL concepts to enhance rendering and interactivity.

projects.title: Document Summary Assistant
projects.subtitle: Multimodal AI Document Intelligence
projects.description: Lightweight multimodal document summarizer built with Next.js and Google Gemini. Ingests PDFs, Office docs, and images with OCR to provide structured bullet summaries and quick takeaways.
